metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (AIRICRAD_NRT 6.7): a self-relation, which should be removed.
No PARENT, INPUT, CHILD or RELATED associations; this run proposes 1 PARENT, 1 RELATED.
ProcessingLevel Id is "1" (the record and documents call the product Level 1C).
TemporalExtents begin 2002-09-06, but NRT products are a 7-day rolling archive and its input AIRIBRAD_NRT begins 2015-12-15.
